## What changed

Describe the focused change and why it belongs in AirESP32ace.

## Verification

- [ ] Companion tests pass.
- [ ] Firmware builds.
- [ ] Hardware behavior was checked when the change affects rendering, input, networking, memory, or power.
- [ ] Visual changes include a screenshot or photo where practical.

## Release safety

- [ ] No API keys, Wi-Fi credentials, generated maps, runtime-downloaded airline/cargo marks, proprietary watch artwork, or proprietary fonts are included.
- [ ] Existing smooth animation and partial-redraw paths remain intact.
- [ ] Documentation was updated when behavior changed.
